source_title: Can I Use Gumroad in My Country?

snippets.snippet_text: "Gumroad enables creators in more than 160 countries to accept payments from their customers. Based on the country you're in, you can either get paid via direct bank deposits, or PayPal. If you live (and have proof that you live) in one of the following countries, you are paid out to your bank account, and in some cases, a debit card. If you live outside of the these countries, you must have a PayPal account, and your account must be verified by PayPal to sell goods on Gumroad. There is no way around this, unfortunately."
"If PayPal is not supported in your country, unfortunately we can not pay you out. We can not use Payoneer, wire deposits, bitcoin, or any other means of money transfer to pay you out."
